subject: Shiny rCharts : xAxis step and zoom labels

messages.author: 3255980cfb4fb14b
messages.subject: Shiny rCharts : xAxis step and zoom labels
parts:
On rCharts with Highcharts and shiny, the x-axis labels are overlapping. I would like to use "step", but i don't know how.
I saw "step: Number"

"To show only every n'th label on the axis, set the step to n. Setting the step to 2 shows every other label.."

This could resolves the issue of overlapping labels on x-axis. But, if I zoom the chart, I would like to see all the labels on x-axis. Is it possible ? How to get it?

h1 <- Highcharts$new()
h1$series(data = env$sites_ac, type="column",name = "Sites Actifs")
h1$series(data = env$sites_al, type="column",name = "Sites Alerte")
h1$series(data = env$ratio, type="spline",marker= list(enabled = FALSE), name = "Percentile")
h1$series(data = env$Temp,  type='spline', marker= list(enabled = FALSE), name = "Temperatures")
h1$series(data = env$NDVI, type = "spline",marker= list(enabled = FALSE), name = "NDVI")
h1$series(data = env$Pmm, type="spline", marker= list(enabled = FALSE),name = "Pmm")
h1$colors('rgba(187, 165, 203, 1)', 'rgba(187, 40, 175, 1)', 'rgba(212,0,0, 1)', 'rgba(243,170,80, .9)','rgba(120,193,102, .9)','rgba(0,0,255, .8)')
h1$legend(symbolWidth = 50)
h1$chart(reduceXTicks=FALSE)
h1$xAxis(type= 'datetime',categories = env$date2)
h1$plotOptions(line=list(marker=list(enabled = F)))
h1$chart(zoomType = "x1")
h1$exporting(enabled = T)

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Shiny rCharts : xAxis step and zoom labels
parts:
Try this one: 

  setExtremes <- "#! 
  function(event) {  
    if (event.max) {       
      this.options.labels.step = 2;  
    } else {    
      this.options.labels.step = 1;  
    };
} !#"

h1$xAxis(list(events = list(setExtremes = setExtremes)))
